Darkrai fixtures

Each page loads the real content scripts with a fake chrome.* API from tests/shim, then checks itself and shows the result in the bottom right corner. Serve this folder over http (node browser/run-fixtures.js does that for you) so that the per-site settings and the framed document work.

Expected to be darkened

  • light - a plain light page
  • css-variables - colours only in custom properties
  • inline - inline styles, !important and legacy attributes
  • low-contrast - the readability guard has to step in
  • shadow-dom - open shadow roots, including a late one
  • iframe - a framed document and a srcdoc frame
  • small-icons - dark icons, and a photo that must not invert

Expected to be left alone

  • native-dark - a site with its own dark theme
  • meta-dark - only a color-scheme meta element
  • runtime-theme-switch - the site turns its own dark theme on after a moment

Expected to use Simple mode

  • canvas-app - text drawn on a canvas
